objective: Recover a conservative, outcome-blind comparison authority for the parent V2.9 lexical candidate-id universe before any V2.9.1 Batch-1 classification, because the exact pre-triage deduped candidate CSV was not archived.
problem: The parent artifact archived downstream results but not the complete pre-triage V2.8.4_CNINFO_CANDIDATE_DEDUPED.csv. Therefore exact historical parent candidate absence cannot be proven from archived bytes alone.

recovery_method.code_authority: Execute the collector file as stored at the exact parent head_sha, not the current branch implementation.
recovery_method.source_scope: CNINFO historical announcement query only, same frozen range, same 18 lexical terms, same SSE/SZSE routes, same 7-day partitions and same dedupe semantics.

validation_gate.recovery_authority_is_conservative: Any replay-only extra IDs are retained in the comparison authority. This can only shrink negative space and therefore cannot create a false discovery-selection-bias positive from an extra replay ID.

admissibility.use: Recovered candidate IDs may be used only as the absence-comparison authority for V2.9.1 negative-space claims.
